item.title: Silent Feast — Strategy & Bluffing Vampire Card Game
item.description: A tense vampire-themed tabletop game where every sip pushes your luck: chain-drink for more BP, risk instant TOX from Vampire or Garlic blood, and outplay others with designate and item tactics.
